title: HR Administrator
description:
We're looking for an HR Administrator for a public sector organisation based in Wiltshire (hybrid) on an initial 12-month contract, paying up to £141 per day (Inside IR35, Umbrella).

There's an expectation to attend the office in Wiltshire around three days a week.

The successful HR Administrator will handle a broad range of HR admin across areas like Learning and Development and employee records. You'll manage shared inboxes, keep employee data accurate, and work as part of a team that flexes resource to where it's needed most. Prioritising your own workload and knowing what to action first will be key.

You will need proven experience working with the following:

Admin or office-based work in a team environment

Inbox management and workload prioritisation

Maintaining data integrity and following set guidelines

Strong attention to detail

Baseline customer service

The following would be beneficial:

A recruitment background

Public sector experience

Level 3 CIPD qualification

You'll need to hold or be eligible to obtain SC clearance.

Interested?

Please apply below.

title: Trainee Accounts Assistant
description:
Trainee Accounts Assistant / Finance Administrator

Devizes £24,000 - £27,000 Permanent Full-time

We are currently recruiting for a Trainee Accounts Assistant / Finance Administrator to join an established legal firm based in Devizes. This is a supporting role within the finance team and would suit a graduate, school leaver or someone with previous administration, finance or customer service experience who is looking to build a career within a professional environment.

You will work closely with the wider finance team, providing day-to-day administrative support and assisting with client transactions and financial processes. Full training will be provided, making this an excellent opportunity for someone who is organised, accurate and keen to develop their knowledge of finance within the legal sector.

The Role
- Providing general administrative support to the finance team
- Assisting with the processing and recording of client transactions
- Supporting the team with client account administration
- Processing and checking financial documentation
- Maintaining accurate records and updating internal systems
- Assisting with the preparation and filing of finance documentation
- Supporting with reconciliations and transaction checks
- Assisting with incoming and outgoing payments
- Responding to internal queries and passing information to the relevant team members
- Liaising with fee earners and other departments to obtain required information
- Carrying out data entry and maintaining accurate financial records
- Supporting the wider finance team with day-to-day administrative tasks
- Providing additional support during busy periods and month-end

About You

This role is open to candidates at all experience levels, including graduates and those looking to take their first step into a finance career. Previous experience within administration, finance, professional services or a customer-facing environment would be beneficial but is not essential.

We are looking for someone who is organised, accurate and comfortable working with confidential information. You will need good attention to detail, strong IT skills and the ability to follow processes carefully. Most importantly, you will be keen to learn, develop your understanding of finance and build a long-term career within a professional legal environment.

The role would suit someone looking for a structured entry point into finance, with the opportunity to gain experience in client transactions, financial administration and the processes involved within a legal firm's finance function.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Location: Devizes (with occasional travel to other sites)

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Salary: Competitive £25-£30 K p/a DOE

About the Company

An established, award-winning organisation with a long-standing history is seeking an Accounts Assistant to join its team. Operating across multiple locations, the business delivers high-quality professional services to a broad client base across the UK.

The company is recognised for its commitment to excellent service, innovation, and a supportive working culture. Employees benefit from a collaborative environment, clear values, and genuine opportunities for professional development and progression.

The Role

This is a key position within the finance function, supporting the organisation's day-to-day financial operations and ensuring the accurate processing of client transactions.

The Accounts Assistant will work closely with multiple departments, playing an important role in maintaining efficient and compliant financial processes.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing day-to-day online client banking activities
- Processing transactions from initial checks through to completion
- Posting financial transactions to client ledgers, including fees, disbursements and payments
- Handling payments via card, cheque and cash
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client ledger records
- Assisting with month-end reporting processes
- Supporting wider finance operations, including payment runs and invoice processing

Skills and Experience Required

Essential
- Experience within a fast-paced accounts or finance environment
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail, with strong data entry skills
- Ability to manage workload effectively and meet deadlines
- Strong communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach
- Team player with the ability to support multiple departments
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office packages

Desirable
- Experience within a professional services environment
- Knowledge of accounting systems such as Sage or similar
- Bookkeeping experience

Benefits
- Competitive salary
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Opportunities for training and career development
- Varied and responsible role within a growing organisation
- Positive company culture with team engagement activities

Apply

If you are a detail-oriented accounts professional looking to develop your career within a well-established and supportive organisation, we would welcome your application.
